Neither date was confirmed to either party.

grades.overall_note: Sound handling. The agent asked the provider to confirm the date, gave the tenant an honest interim update and held the ticket with a follow-up. It missed a full event-by-event account of where each date came from, and did not offer to chase an earlier visit.
